pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions exhibit non-uniform, complex polygonal geometries with highly crenulated, jagged edges. Pixel-level transitions show high contrast with dendritic-like extensions into the negative space.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-toned pixels forming a topological graph between dark patches. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radial and quadri-radial. Corridor thickness is narrow relative to patch area, maintaining high continuity across the visible flank and neck.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the dorsal neck displays a high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated profile consisting of short, stiff vertical hair filaments visible against the background.
